description:
Calculate RS3 resale-profit scenarios after seller tax. ESTIMATE ONLY; never places an order. Use get_item_details for price detail, compare_item_prices for snapshots, or lookup_item for uncertain names.

itemId skips name resolution; name resolves first. quantity scales total investment, tax and profit, not per-unit margin.

An omitted price uses Weirdgloop, then Jagex guide price. Omitting both gives identical buy/sell prices, usually a tax loss. Supply itemId and both prices to calculate without network access.

Tax is 2% of each unit's sell price, rounded down. Bonds and sales at 50 coins or less are exempt.

For quantity=20 and buyLimitRemaining=5, quota profit covers five units; requested totals still cover twenty. fillTimeMinutes divides the full-request profit into an hourly rate, including any assumed quota wait. Both inputs are caller assumptions, not observed limits or fill predictions.

Sampled prices lag live offers. No credentials or cache. HTTP defaults to 60 requests/IP/minute; honor 429 Retry-After.

buyLimitRemaining.description: Caller-supplied remaining purchase quota in the current buy-limit window; 0 means none available

buyPrice.description: Buy price per item in coins. Defaults to the latest Weirdgloop sample, then Jagex guide price.

fillTimeMinutes.description: Caller-assumed minutes to buy and resell the full requested quantity, including any quota waits

itemId.description: Grand Exchange item ID (provide itemId or name)

name.description: Item name (provide itemId or name). Prefer lookup_item for fuzzy search.

sellPrice.description: Sell price per item in coins. Defaults to the latest Weirdgloop sample, then Jagex guide price.

name: estimate_flip

outputSchema.description: Flip estimate after the RS3 2% seller tax. marginPct is null when the buy cost is 0.

buyPrice.description: Buy price per item in coins

executionScenario.description: Present only for caller-supplied capacity or duration scenarios; not a market prediction

assumedNetProfitPerHour.description: Full requested profit divided by caller-assumed round-trip hours

netProfitWithinBuyLimit.description: Tax-adjusted profit on the quantity executable within the supplied quota

sellPrice.description: Sell price per item in coins

title: Estimate Flip Profit
